card.name: Opportunity or chance to do something
card.fires_on: The noun 'opportunity' (also 'chance' or 'time') or the 'to' right after it, where it introduces what a situation is being used for. Mostly in phrases like 'take this opportunity to' or 'a chance to'.

modes.label: Opportunity noun
modes.description: The word 'opportunity' after 'use the', 'take this' or 'an', before 'to' plus a verb.
modes.example: We take this<< opportunity>> to affirm our shared commitment to an academic

modes.label: Chance or time to
modes.description: 'time' or 'chance' (or the following 'to') framing a moment as suited to an action.
modes.example: Mid-morning is usually a good<< time>> to pollinate flowers. There is no

modes.label: To after chance
modes.description: The word 'to' following 'chance' or 'time', before the intended action verb.
modes.example: Howse sees Scale Structure Synthesis as a chance<< to>> demystify a world rarely glimpsed

card.plain: It marks phrases like 'an opportunity to' or 'a good time to', where a moment is presented as a chance to do something.
